description: This file defines the ThingAcknowledgementFactory class which provides factory methods to create instances of Acknowledgement related to 'Things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods to instantiate acknowledgments, parse JSON representations into acknowledgment objects, and a nested JsonParser class dedicated to parsing acknowledgment JSON data.

classes.name: ThingAcknowledgementFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing factory methods to create and parse Acknowledgement instances specific to 'Things'.

classes.name: JsonParser
classes.description: Nested static class extending AcknowledgementJsonParser, specialized to parse JSON into Acknowledgement objects with ThingId entities.

methods.name: newAcknowledgement
methods.description: Creates a new Acknowledgement instance with specified label, ThingId, status code, headers, and optional payload.

methods.name: newAcknowledgement
methods.description: Creates a new Acknowledgement instance with specified label, ThingId, status code, and headers; payload defaults to null.

methods.name: getJsonParser
methods.description: Returns a new instance of JsonParser for parsing JSON data into acknowledgements.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JsonObject into an Acknowledgement instance using the JsonParser.
